content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Paragraph 18.1 (p0228) is the renewal analogue in this consortium C&M Agreement — the Agreement continues in operation after the 25-year Initial Period, with our only unilateral exit being one (1) year's prior written notice. That 365-day window exceeds both the 60-day fallback ceiling and the 90-day walk-away threshold, so it fails the fallback on a material term (classified **deviation**). Paragraphs 18.2–18.3 offer no shorter individual exit (unanimous consent during the Initial Period; two-thirds decommissioning vote thereafter), and there is no renewal price-uplift mechanic (costs flow through actual Capital/O&M Costs under Schedule B), so the price-cap element is not engaged and is recorded as already met on the continuation language.

The redline is a single surgical replacement — "one (1) year's" → "sixty (60) days'" — preserving the rest of 18.1 and all downstream realization-of-assets and continuing-liability mechanics.
